title: Groups of Special-Equivalent Strings
description: Group strings by their character counts at even and odd indices.
pseudocode:
1. Initialize set 'seen'
2. For each word in words:
3.   Count chars at even indices and odd indices separately
4.   Form a normalized key from these counts
5.   Add key to 'seen'
6. Return size of 'seen'

steps.note: Initialize an empty set to store unique normalized string representations.
Process 'abcd': even indices {'a', 'c'}, odd indices {'b', 'd'}. Key: 'ac:bd'
Process 'cdab': even {'c', 'a'}, odd {'d', 'b'}. Key: 'ac:bd'. Already in set.
Process 'cbad': even {'c', 'a'}, odd {'b', 'd'}. Key: 'ac:bd'. Already in set.
Process 'xyzz': even {'x', 'z'}, odd {'y', 'z'}. Key: 'xz:yz'. New entry.
Process 'zzxy': even {'z', 'x'}, odd {'z', 'y'}. Key: 'xz:yz'. Already in set.
Process 'zzyx': even {'z', 'y'}, odd {'z', 'x'}. Key: 'yz:xz'. New entry.
Final count of groups in the set is 3.
